# software id = <redacted-by-obi>
#
# model = CRS318-16P-2S+
# serial number = E203A2A4A9E2
/interface bridge add admin-mac=02:A9:D1:40:D0:63 auto-mac=no igmp-snooping=yes igmp-version=3 membership-interval=20m30s mld-version=2 name=bridge priority=0x4000 vlan-filtering=yes
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether3 ] name=ether3-chestnut-ap-tower
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether5 ] name=ether5-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-05 poe-out=forced-on
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether7 ] name=ether7-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-60 poe-out=forced-on poe-voltage=high
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether9 ] name=ether9-chestnut-ptmp-100-05 poe-out=forced-on poe-voltage=low
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether11 ] name=ether11-chestnut-ptmp-120-05 poe-out=forced-on
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether13 ] name=ether13-chestnut-ptmp-160-05 poe-out=forced-on
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether15 ] name=ether15-chestnut-ptmp-180-05 poe-out=forced-on
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether16 ] name=ether16-access-mgmt
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus1 ] name=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus2 ] name=sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan105-mgmt vlan-id=105
/interface bonding add mode=802.3ad name=bond-chestnut-gw slaves=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12 transmit-hash-policy=layer-2-and-3
/interface ethernet switch port-isolation set 2 forwarding-override=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12,switch1-cpu
/interface ethernet switch port-isolation set 8 forwarding-override=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12,switch1-cpu
/interface ethernet switch port-isolation set 10 forwarding-override=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12,switch1-cpu
/interface ethernet switch port-isolation set 12 forwarding-override=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12,switch1-cpu
/interface ethernet switch port-isolation set 14 forwarding-override=sfp-sfpplus1-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus11,sfp-sfpplus2-chestnut-gw-sfp-sfpplus12,switch1-cpu
/interface list add name=rf-access
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/system logging action set 0 memory-lines=65535
/system logging action set 1 disk-file-count=8
/system logging action set 3 remote=172.18.81.101
/interface bridge filter add action=drop chain=forward comment="no RF-to-RF reflection (software path)" in-interface-list=rf-access out-interface-list=rf-access
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=bond-chestnut-gw
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether16-access-mgmt pvid=105
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether3-chestnut-ap-tower pvid=2000
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether9-chestnut-ptmp-100-05 pvid=2000
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether11-chestnut-ptmp-120-05 pvid=2000
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether13-chestnut-ptmp-160-05 pvid=2000
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether15-chestnut-ptmp-180-05 pvid=2000
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether7-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-60 pvid=521
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether5-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-05 pvid=522
/ip neighbor discovery-settings set discover-interface-list=all
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge,bond-chestnut-gw,ether9-chestnut-ptmp-100-05,ether11-chestnut-ptmp-120-05,ether13-chestnut-ptmp-160-05,ether15-chestnut-ptmp-180-05,ether7-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-60,ether5-chestnut-ptp-zelkova-05 untagged=ether16-access-mgmt vlan-ids=105
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bond-chestnut-gw vlan-ids=2000
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bond-chestnut-gw vlan-ids=521
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bond-chestnut-gw vlan-ids=522
/interface list member add interface=ether9-chestnut-ptmp-100-05 list=rf-access
/interface list member add interface=ether11-chestnut-ptmp-120-05 list=rf-access
/interface list member add interface=ether13-chestnut-ptmp-160-05 list=rf-access
/interface list member add interface=ether15-chestnut-ptmp-180-05 list=rf-access
/interface list member add interface=ether3-chestnut-ap-tower list=rf-access
/interface ovpn-server server add mac-address=02:49:7D:50:03:28 name=ovpn-server1
/ip dhcp-client add disabled=yes interface=bridge
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan105-mgmt
/ip user-8 profile set [ find default=yes ] html-directory=user-8
/ip ipsec profile set [ find default=yes ] dpd-interval=2m dpd-maximum-failures=5
/ip ssh set forwarding-enabled=both password-authentication=yes
/ipv6 nd set [ find default=yes ] advertise-dns=yes
/system clock set time-zone-name=America/Los_Angeles
/system identity set name=chestnut-sw-tower
/system logging set 0 topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=error
/system logging add action=remote topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=info
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system package update set channel=long-term
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/tool sniffer set file-name=chestnut-sw-tower.pcap filter-direction=tx filter-interface=ether9-chestnut-ptmp-100-05 filter-ip-address=224.0.0.1/32 filter-ip-protocol=igmp filter-mac-address=02:0a:95:e9:d7:ca/02:22:EC:AC:93:CA memory-limit=4096KiB
